facts.activity_file: setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: near hit during a planned shutdown on PSV-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was never verified as effective, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices on PSV-7103 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in verifying pressure relief and protection, specifically setting, testing and sealing pressure relief devices. PSV-7103 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment was not in place. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 9 May 2008 a near hit was recorded on PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during a planned shutdown; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
